lines: Welcome to camp. The armies of Israel and the Philistines face each other across the Valley of Elah.
Goliath challenges Israel’s army. You are a witness; David will confront him.
Here is a detail from the account: David chose five smooth stones from the stream. Let us test what you remember.
Look beyond the riverbed. The Philistine camp is over there; we stand on Israel’s side.
In 1 Samuel 17:8–11, Goliath demands that Israel choose a man to fight him. Saul and the soldiers are deeply afraid.
I will not ask you to fight. Go to the blue tent; the veteran can tell you more.
It was not a single challenge. According to 1 Samuel 17:16, the Philistine appeared for forty days, morning and evening.
That helps explain the fear hanging over the camp. But the account continues; David will have a crucial role.
You are a witness to this account. Let us check what you learned about the length of the challenge.
Speak to the soldier by the blue banner first.
The lookout by the red banner is waiting for you.
Visit the veteran beside the blue tent.
You completed the first two missions. Meeting David will arrive in a later development stage.
